>
[Remorhaz Armor](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1852)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 19 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 975 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Niyaháat](/Armor.aspx?ID=31)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [fire-resistant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=283) [niyaháat](/Armor.aspx?ID=31)_ is often created to mark the passage of an Erutaki warrior into adulthood, formed from the chitinous plates of a remorhaz, with larger pieces protecting the chest, shoulders, and head. As you fight, the armor glows red hot.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor is sheathed in a [_fire shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=118).

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You're dealt 30 or more fire damage, before any reduction from your fire resistance; **Requirements** You've used the _fire shield_ activation already today; **Effect** The _fire shield_ activation recharges.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the carapace of a [remorhaz](/Monsters.aspx?ID=351).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
